name: Sunrise Apartments
description: A well-maintained complex in the heart of downtown. Close to public transport and major shopping. Management is responsive and the community is quiet — a solid first choice for new renters.

reviews.text: Great location, responsive landlord. Heating works perfectly all winter.
Nice building overall. A bit pricey but worth it for the amenities.
Maintenance can be slow on weekends, but they do fix things eventually.

name: Greenview Tower
description: Modern high-rise with panoramic city views and upscale finishes. Ideal for professionals. Note: the elevator had ongoing maintenance issues in 2024 — worth asking management about current status.

reviews.text: Landlord ignored multiple requests about the broken elevator for weeks.
Great views and modern interiors. Street noise can be an issue at night.
Generally a good place. Management improved a lot in the past year.

name: Lakeside Studios
description: Cosy studios with stunning lake views. Perfect for students or solo professionals. The landlord is highly responsive and tenants consistently praise the peaceful atmosphere.

reviews.text: Best landlord I have ever had. Issues fixed same day. Highly recommend.
Super quiet, beautiful views, management genuinely cares about tenants.

name: Heritage Flats
description: Charming apartments inside a restored 1920s heritage building. High ceilings, original hardwood floors, and a shared garden. Some units have older plumbing — always ask before signing.

reviews.text: Beautiful building. The character is unmatched. Old heating but it works fine.
Lovely place but the pipes are noisy at night. Management was responsive when I raised it.

name: The Pinebrook
description: A well-kept mid-rise in a quiet residential neighbourhood. Units have private balconies and in-unit laundry — rare at this price point. Management is professional and repairs are handled promptly.

reviews.text: In-unit laundry is a game changer. Building is clean and well managed.
Quiet neighbourhood, good value. Parking can be tight on weekends.
Solid apartment. Balcony is small but usable. Would renew.

name: Harborview Residences
description: Luxury waterfront condos with direct harbor views from every unit. Modern finishes, floor-to-ceiling windows, and a rooftop deck with grills. Premium price but hard to beat the location and quality.

reviews.text: Waking up to harbor views every morning never gets old. Worth every cent.
Beautiful building and great amenities. Concierge is very helpful.
Stunning location but the HOA rules are strict and management can be slow on non-urgent repairs.

name: Cedarwood Commons
description: Spacious two-storey townhouses in a quiet gated community. Great for families or anyone needing extra space. Each unit has a private patio and attached garage. Schools and parks are within walking distance.

reviews.text: Best rental we have had. Tons of space, private garage, great neighbours.
Perfect for our family. Kids love the patio and it feels like a real home.
Very spacious. The gated entrance gives real peace of mind.

name: Metro Lofts
description: Industrial-style lofts in a converted warehouse in the heart of the Arts District. Soaring 14-foot ceilings, exposed brick, and open floor plans. Units are full of character — not ideal for those who need traditional bedroom separation.

reviews.text: The space is incredible. High ceilings, great light, perfect for my home studio.
Love the aesthetic. The open plan can make it noisy but it suits my lifestyle.
Cool building but zero sound insulation between units. You hear everything.

name: Willowbrook Gardens
description: Affordable garden-facing apartments in a low-rise complex. Popular with students and young professionals. Management enforces quiet hours strictly which keeps the community peaceful. Close to the university and bus routes.

reviews.text: Great price for the area. Quiet, clean, and close to campus.
Management is decent. Garden view from my window is lovely in spring.
Affordable but the laundry room is often busy. Units are a bit dated.

name: Ashford Place
description: Compact but smartly designed studios in a modern building. Optional furnished packages make this ideal for short-stay or first-time renters. Keyless entry and package lockers are a practical touch. Great transport links nearby.

reviews.text: Moved in furnished and it was seamless. Compact but extremely well laid out.
Perfect starter apartment. Roof terrace is a great bonus.
Smart building, easy management. Small but very liveable.

name: Redstone Court
description: Popular with graduate students and young professionals. High-speed internet is included in rent and the building has dedicated study rooms. 24-hour maintenance line is a genuine plus. Lively neighbourhood — can be noisy on weekends.

reviews.text: Internet included is amazing. Study rooms are quiet and well equipped.
Good value but weekends can get loud. Management responds fast though.
Very convenient location. 24hr maintenance line actually works — used it once at midnight and someone came.

name: Foxglove Terrace
description: Bright, modern apartments with private terraces in the sought-after Garden District. Each unit has a full-size dishwasher and dedicated storage cage. Management has a strong reputation. Units rarely stay vacant for long.

reviews.text: The terrace sold it for me. Beautiful place to have morning coffee. Management is top notch.
Best apartment I have rented. Clean, modern, management actually cares.
Lovely area and well maintained. Would not leave if rent wasn't going up.

name: Irongate Suites
description: Premium high-rise condos in the Financial District targeting executives and corporate tenants. Smart home systems, valet parking, and a private residents' lounge. Management is formal and professional. High price reflects the premium offering.

reviews.text: Everything is top tier. Doorman knows your name within a week. Worth the premium.
Excellent building. Smart home setup took some getting used to but works brilliantly.
Great amenities but management is very formal and slow to bend on anything. Read your lease carefully.

name: Cloverfield Walk
description: Charming riverside townhouses with private gardens and river views. Original fireplaces have been restored and work beautifully in winter. A rare find at this price for the size and outdoor space. Landlord is an independent owner — very hands-on and communicative.

reviews.text: The fireplace and garden are incredible. Landlord is the best I have ever dealt with.
We renewed immediately. River views, private garden, amazing value for what you get.
Lovely home. The riverbank walk right outside the door is a bonus every morning.
